title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore West on 1969-06-05
lineage: SBD > MC > C > D > CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard cassette with some hiss and flatness but overall good clarity captures a tight June‑69 Fillmore show highlighted by The Eleven, Dark Star and an epic Lovelight.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently strong, with the band in fine form throughout; standout moments include a ferocious Me & My Uncle, a scorching Cryptical > Other One > Cryptical sandwich, a monster The Eleven, and a 25‑minute Lovelight that pushes the second set into legendary territory.  The soundboard cassette has noticeable tape hiss and occasional flat or pitch‑problem sections, but it remains listenable and conveys the excitement of this June ’69 run.

ai_rating.rationale: The overwhelming majority of reviews are 4–5 stars praising the musical performance; recording issues are noted but not severe enough to outweigh the show quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Hissy cassette source with a slightly flat tonal balance and an occasional pitch‑problem section; overall decent clarity and mix for a 1969 audience recording.

standout_songs: China Cat > Sittin' in the Summer Sun
He Was a Friend of Mine
show_quality.setlist_flow: A tight, consistently high‑energy set that builds into a powerful second half; long improvisational jams flow smoothly, with The Eleven and Lovelight serving as the climactic peaks.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for his soaring guitar tone, flawless vocals and an 'other‑level' performance throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: No explicit performance comments; one reviewer suggested adding a bit more bass on the EQ to balance the mix.
